name: LAMPF-0764
full_name: Los Alamos Meson Physics Facility Experiment E764
summary: LAMPF E764 studied neutrino interactions and searched for muon-to-electron appearance at energies near the muon-production threshold using the Los Alamos accelerator source.
physics_targets: Muon-neutrino interactions on carbon near threshold
detection_principle: A liquid-scintillator detector measured charged-particle light from neutrino interactions, with neutrinos from pion decay in flight providing the muon-neutrino sample. Electron-like events were compared with intrinsic and non-neutrino backgrounds to test flavour appearance.

sites.name: United States; LAMPF at Los Alamos
sites.location: United States; LAMPF at Los Alamos

status.label: Completed / historical
status.evidence: The EPAC 1988 experiment-team report describes the bare-target exposure as finished; a final carbon cross-section paper appeared in December 1992.

timeline.event: Independent checks of the neutrino-flux calculation completed according to the PI report
Final inclusive and exclusive carbon charged-current measurement published

collaboration.name: LAMPF-0764 Collaboration
collaboration.participants_note: Institutions listed here are selected documented participants; the official collaboration page provides the complete membership.

key_parameters.name: Proton beam
key_parameters.value: 800 MeV protons on a bare water target

key_parameters.name: Neutrino source
key_parameters.value: Pion decay in flight along a 12 m channel

key_parameters.name: Detector
key_parameters.value: 4.5-ton liquid-scintillator cylinder, approximately 2 m in diameter and height

key_parameters.name: Baseline and shielding
key_parameters.value: Detector centre 21 m from the target, behind 8 m of iron and magnetite

results.summary: Published limits on muon-to-electron appearance near the muon threshold.

Measured the flux-averaged inclusive carbon charged-current cross section as (15.9 +/- 2.6 statistical +/- 3.7 systematic) x 10^-39 square centimetres, and also isolated a small exclusive nitrogen-12 ground-state sample.

science_scope: The record describes the named experiment as one programme; detector subsystems and repeated analyses are not counted as independent experiments.
